method: Official client playing two original WAVs from its local library. Production PlaybackController performed each action once and read the actual helper reply; concurrent read-only global snapshots identified transitions. No account login. No manufactured Now Playing metadata.
offFocus: With Music as current system owner, the QQ pinned selection correctly observed its real title and progress and blocked transport. An explicit QQ file-open granted the system source to QQ.
before: Equal title, same track, multiple observed content UUIDs, including updates before actual next-track title and after resume. Resume command at Unix 1795691451.383, global playing became true between 1795691453.37 and 1795691453.70, beyond the former confirmation window. Paused snapshots retained advancing playbackRate=1 with elapsed=0 from the beginning of that track.
after: Ignore ephemeral UUID only on the observed QQ build, keep other catalog IDs. Treat contradictory paused/positive-rate anchor as temporarily unavailable. The confirmation window allows slower QQ reads while commands are still sent once.
